name: game-view-record
description: Records the Game View in Play Mode as an mp4 for a person to review a run (to look back yourself: screenshot-game-view storyboard:true). Returns at once; the end is the journal event in waitFor ('[ChievFX][record] #<n> done <file.mp4> ...', or 'frames_only <dir>' without ffmpeg), awaitMs waits for it. A slow editor records fewer frames.

seconds.description: Seconds of real time to record.

fps.description: Frames per second of the video.

savePath.description: Where to put the finished mp4: a .mp4 file or a folder, absolute or relative to the project. It is moved there out of Logs/chievfx_video; the done event names this path.

stop.description: true: stop the running recording now and build what was captured.
